$comment: The model registry and routing policy. Models are data: add or adjust one in your own ~/.claude/model-router.json, or per project in .claude/model-router.json (same shape, merged key by key). strength, speed and cost are relative ranks. A model's name must be an alias the Agent tool accepts (haiku, sonnet, opus, fable). Crew models must match each agent's frontmatter; the tests check that. Levels pair a strength with an effort: on current models effort is the cheaper lever, so complex and hardest share Opus and differ in effort. Prices are USD per million tokens on the Anthropic API, used only to report spend: a key is one model version, or ends in -* to cover every version of a family, and a version with no entry is reported as unpriced. Prices can be added or changed in your own ~/.claude/model-router.json only, not a project's file. cache_write is the five-minute cache write price and cache_write_1h the one-hour one, which is twice input when left out. A shipped long_prompt block holds the prices a request pays when its prompt (input, cache reads and cache writes) is over its `over` tokens; each request is priced on its own (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing.md, Long context pricing). `schema` is the version of this shape; an override may carry it too, and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Compatibility" says what changes it.

haiku.use_for: Lookups, file search, summarizing known code, running a command and reporting, formatting, trivial edits.

sonnet.use_for: Everyday implementation at high effort: features and fixes with a clear spec, tests, refactors inside one module.

opus.use_for: Design and planning, cross-module changes, subtle bugs, security-sensitive code, adversarial review. On coding it came within a point of Fable at the same effort for under a quarter of the cost.

fable.use_for: Research-grade and open-ended work: ambiguous multi-system problems with no known approach, long investigations, and retries after Opus at xhigh fell short.

main.$comment: Effort for the main conversation per turn, by the request's level. Only raises: a level below what the session already runs at is left alone.

verifier.role: Runs tests, lint and type checks and reports results

docs-researcher.role: Reads current Claude Code docs and changelog

implementer.role: Writes code and tests to a clear spec

architect.role: Plans changes and designs systems, read-only

deep-solver.role: Research-grade, open-ended tasks with no known approach
